title: Diagnostic output contract
description: Structure returned by the engine for every run. COMPLETED outputs always carry a full diagnosis block. FAILED outputs carry processing_status FAILED, populated error_flags, and the decision_trace up to the failing stage. Missing information appears only as null, UNKNOWN, or a defined error flag; it is never substituted with an assumption.

incident_id.description: Echo of input incident_id, or the literal UNKNOWN when the input could not be parsed.

contributing_diagnoses.description: Additional qualified modes, deterministic order (score desc, tie-break priority asc, id byte order). Empty for UNKNOWN_ROOT_CAUSE.

confidence_score.description: Integer per the declared formula; null only for UNKNOWN_ROOT_CAUSE.

timestamp_normalized.description: UTC-normalized ISO-8601 or null when no timezone is known or parsing failed. Null is never filled by guessing.

integrity_status_effective.description: Input status, possibly downgraded by engine rules; never upgraded.

missing_groups.description: Human-readable required-group descriptions that did not match.

note.description: Always states that the embedded instruction was not executed.

unknown_fields.description: Input fields outside the documented set, preserved and never used.

missing_required_evidence.description: Smallest missing items that would allow further discrimination, ordered deterministically.

immediate_execution_stop.description: True when any selected remediation step has action_kind STOP_EXECUTION_NOW.

timeline_resolved.description: False when any order-relevant timestamp lacks a timezone or verified sources assert conflicting event order.

stage.description: One of the 18 pipeline stage names.

error_flags.description: Empty array means no error flags raised. TIMELINE_UNRESOLVED is compatible with COMPLETED.

canonical_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the output with canonical_sha256 removed and audit_results emptied. Present only when processing_status is COMPLETED.
